proposals: The Central Electricity Authority should publish a quarterly storage dashboard listing BESS and pumped-storage capacity as installed, under construction, tendered and cancelled, in both GW and GWh, so the market’s size is read from one official series rather than from Mercom, IESA and IEEFA-JMK figures that do not reconcile.

The Central Electricity Authority should publish a project-wise pumped-storage pipeline with a written definition of each stage, including “under construction”, so snapshots of 8 projects/10 GW and 4 GW under construction can be traced to a single list.

SECI and state utilities such as GUVNL and APTRANSCO should publish every BESS auction result in a common format: tariff, duration, cycles per day, VGF status and winning bidders, so tariff declines are measured like-for-like rather than across mismatched tenders.

The Ministry of Heavy Industries should publish ACC PLI capacity awarded and commissioned by beneficiary every quarter, against each firm’s contractual milestone dates, so the gap between 40 GWh awarded and 1.4 GWh commissioned can be tracked firm by firm.

The Ministry of Power should publish the disbursement milestones for VGF Tranche II and the amounts released to each state and NTPC, so the ₹5,400 crore tranche can be followed in the same way as Tranche I’s financial-closure and COD-linked payments.
